title: The Sales Type column header does not sort the report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Today {Sales-rep-A} holds only the Labor side of one invoiced split work order, and {Sales-rep-B} holds its Parts side; neither has other invoices today.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, with Show Unassigned on and the Sales Type column turned on.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: nothing happens; the Sales Type column cannot be sorted.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: "SBR (Sales By Representative) Report" spec, Confluence 585629698, version 28 (12 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • Sales By Representative spec, S11-R6: “Identifier columns are not sortable (Date, Invoice, Customer, Status, Sales Type do not respond to header clicks). The Date header carries the expand/collapse-all chevron, not a sort affordance.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
